title: $0.25 Bonus Cashback for Completing a ShopBack Survey (Limited Rewards) @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: $0.25 Bonus Cashback for Completing a ShopBack Survey (Limited Rewards) @ ShopBack

[Herbs] Anyone else get "We couldn't connect you to the store, likely due to a temporary connection issue. Please try again"?
[VladImpaler] Yep, won't work even after restarting the app.
[trixieb] Hey Hipho, I saw this offer earlier but it doesn't link to a survey and says store is temporarily unavailable.
I can't see the store name. Did you do the survey and receive 25c?
I did other surveys recently and they didn't pay or track. Seems to be a hit or miss much like the receipts.
[Hiphopopotamus] Yeah I got it, had to do it on the website as the app has a connection error.
[alvian] It worked on iPhone app. It did not work on Android app.
[dyara15] Survey completed with “Thank you for your time! Your reward will be with you very soon.” However, it hasnt recognised that the survey was successfully completed yet nor begun tracking as it still shows 0/1 completed. Might take time to track or a glitch.
[Lucille Bluth] Also loving their new feature where you have to click the "claim" button to get the cashback in the quest. If you forget to click you won't get the cashback, pretty dodgy.
